subject: CS475
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 of 5 English videos and 3 of 5 Arabic videos. For English, strong candidates were available for all topics, including modern best practices with ViewModels and official Google talks. For Arabic, coverage was good for core lifecycle topics from a few key channels, but no suitable videos were found for the more advanced 'System-Initiated Process Death' or the introductory 'Handling Configuration Changes' topics, with candidates failing relevance or view count gates.

videos.title: Explained - Android Activity Life Cycle
videos.filter_reason: A concise and clear explanation of the entire activity lifecycle, which is essential for understanding the subtle differences between states like onPause and onStop.

videos.title: 114 Android Activity Fragment Combined Lifecycle |
videos.filter_reason: With a perfect title 'Android Activity Fragment Combined Lifecycle' and high view count, this video directly and concisely addresses the complex interaction between the two lifecycles.

videos.title: Process Death and ViewModels (My apps are BROKEN)
videos.filter_reason: This video provides deep conceptual understanding by linking state saving not just to rotation, but to the critical case of process death, and introduces the modern SavedStateHandle.

videos.title: Best practices for saving UI state on Android
videos.filter_reason: An official Google I/O talk from the Android Developers channel that directly explains best practices for handling UI state during system-initiated process death.

videos.title: فيديو #105 | دورة حياة الأكتيفيتي Activity Life-cycle
videos.filter_reason: This is a clear, well-regarded explanation of the Activity Lifecycle from a popular Arabic channel, providing the necessary context to distinguish between onPause and onStop.

videos.title: فيديو #270 | دورة حياة الـ Fragment نظري
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a solid theoretical explanation of the Fragment lifecycle and its relationship to the Activity, which is crucial for understanding this complex topic.

videos.title: فيديو #108 | دوال حفظ البيانات في دورة حياة الفعالية
videos.filter_reason: This video clearly explains the concept and purpose of the onSaveInstanceState and onRestoreInstanceState methods, making it a perfect choice for this topic.
